title: The Crafter’s Curse
description: Build Name: ⚙️ "The Crafter's Curse" Genre: Tech-Magic Hardcore Progression Dungeon Crawler Main Idea: In this world, the knowledge of handcrafting has disappeared. Steve has "forgotten" how to make complex items by hand.
body:
🌑 The Crafter’s Curse
The Crafter’s Curse is an adventure techno-magical mod that transforms the familiar world of Minecraft into a dangerous but exciting challenge. Are you ready to face the curse head-on?

⚔️ Mod Features
Dynamic Combat: Thanks to the Better Combat mod, battles are fluid and tactical. Use a huge arsenal from Simply Swords to find your play style.
The Age of Engineering: Immerse yourself in a world of mechanisms with the Create mod. Automate everything from wheat farms to complex steam-powered factories.
Smart Storage: Forget about the chaos in your chests with Tom's Simple Storage. Manage all your resources from a single terminal.
Exploration without limits: Find unique treasures in dungeons with the Lootr system, where every player gets their reward, and navigate the world with Xaero's maps.
Maximum performance: The build is based on Sodium and Iris, ensuring high FPS and support for the most beautiful shaders.
📦 List of key mods Category Mods Technology Create, Create Crafts & Additions Combat Better Combat, Simply Swords, Weapon Trails Interface EMI, Xaero's Minimap & World Map Storage Tom's Simple Storage Mod Optimization Sodium, Iris, Flywheel, Lithium World and Loot Lootr, KubeJS (Custom scripts)
🚀 Why choose The Crafter's Curse?
1. Balance: We have combined the magic of exploration with the precision of engineering.

2. Aesthetics: Visual effects for hits and shader support make the game incredibly beautiful.
